ENF2 Ref: EC2024/0118 - Address: 88 Sandy Lane SouthWallingtonSM6 9RQ - Complaint: Alleged: Breach of condition five (5) of D2017/76639 - Additional floor space occupied for purposes NOT ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling at 88 Sandy Lane - Status: PCO

decision_conditions: The removal of condition 5 (the additional floor space not to be used as a separate unit of residential accommodation) of planning permission Ref: DM2018/00730) would be unacceptable in principle. The removal of condition 5 could facilitate the conversion of the original dwellinghouse to create separate unit/s of residential accommodation which would by reason of the application site's location outside an Area of Potential Intensification and falling below the existing GIA (excluding extensions) being less than 125sq.m for conversion, would result in a loss of small housing within the borough. In addition it is also not considered that the proposed development would provide a better-designed, higher-quality new housing, than that offered by the existing 3 bed house.  The proposals if approved would therefore be contrary to Policy 10 of the Sutton's Local Plan 2018.

The removal of condition 5 (the additional floor space not to be used as a separate unit of residential accommodation) of planning permission Ref: DM2018/00730) would be unacceptable in principle. The removal of condition 5 could facilitate the conversion of the original dwellinghouse to create separate unit/s of residential accommodation which by reason of substandard gross internal floor space and layout and lack of identifiable private external amenity space could result in a cramped and unsatisfactory living conditions for the occupants which would therefore be contrary to Policy D6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 9 of Sutton's Local Plan 2018, and Sutton's Urban Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (SPD) 14 "Creating Locally Distinctive Places".

The removal of condition 5 (the additional floor space not to be used as a separate unit of residential accommodation) of planning permission Ref: DM2018/00730) would be unacceptable in principle. The removal of condition 5 could facilitate the conversion of the original dwellinghouse to create separate unit/s of residential accommodation. The current application to removed condition 5 without evidence to the contrary, has failed to provide evidence of satisfactory reduction in carbon emissions, sustainable drainage measures and water efficiency measures. As such, the application would be contrary to Policies 31, 32 and 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
